1: Is surah ka aaghaz un alag alag huroof se hota hai jin ki wazahat Surah Al-Baqarah mein pehle guzar chuki hai.
2: Aey Rasool, Maine aap par Quran is liye nahin utara ke aap apni qaum ke is par iman laane se munh modne par dukhi hon.
3: Hum ne use sirf un logon ke liye nasihat bana kar utara jinhein Allah ne nawaza hai taake woh Us se darein.
4: Use us Allah ne utara jis ne zameen aur buland aasman paida kiye. Lihaza yeh ek azeem Quran hai, kyunke use ek Azeem Hasti ne utara.
5: Rehman, jo Arsh par qayam hua, aise maani mein jo Us ki azmat ke laayak hai, paak hai Woh.
6: Aasmaano aur zameen ki har cheez, aur jo kuch mitti ke neeche hai, sab sirf Usi ki hai, paak hai Woh. Usi ne un sab ko paida kiya, Wohi un ka maalik hai aur Wohi unhein chalata hai.
7: Aey Rasool, agar aap koi baat buland aawaz se kahein ya use chhipayein, Woh, paak hai Woh, yeh sab jaanta hai. Woh chhipi baatein aur un se bhi zyada chhipi cheezein jaanta hai, jaise dil ke khayalat. Us se kuch chhipa nahin.
8: Allah, Us ke siwa koi ibadat ke laayak nahin. Usi akele ke liye woh behtareen naam hain jo kamaal aur khoobi ke sab se mukammal darje tak pahunche hue hain.
9: Aey Rasool, aap ke paas Moosa (alaihis salaam) ibn-e-Imran ka qissa aa chuka hai.
10: Jab unhon ne safar ke dauran ek aag dekhi aur apne ghar walon se kaha: yahin thehro, mujhe ek aag dikhayi de rahi hai. Shayad main us mein se koi jalta hua angaara tumhare paas laa sakoon ya koi aisa shaks paa loon jo mujhe raasta dikhaye.
11: Phir jab woh aag ke paas aaye to Allah ne, paak hai Woh, unhein pukara aur farmaya: aey Moosa (alaihis salaam).
12: Main tumhara Rubb hoon. Apne joote utaar do, Mujh se baat-cheet ki tayyari mein. Tum paak ki hui waadi, yani Tuwa mein ho.
13: Aur aey Moosa (alaihis salaam), Maine tumhein apna paigham pahunchane ke liye chun liya, lihaza us par kaan dharo jo Main tumhari taraf wahi karta hoon.
14: Main hi Allah hoon; Mere siwa koi ibadat ke laayak nahin. Lihaza sirf Meri ibadat karo aur namaz poore tareeqe se qayam karo taake tum us mein Mujhe yaad karo.
15: Qayamat be-shak aane wali hai aur woh zaroor hogi. Main use chhipaye rakhta hoon taake koi makhlooq us ka waqt na jaane, magar woh us ki nishaniyon se waaqif hain, us khabar se jo un ke paas bheje gaye nabi ne unhein di, taake har jaan ko us ke kiye ka badla mile, achha ho ya bura.
16: Aur woh kafir jo us par iman nahin rakhte aur apni na-jaiz khwahishon ke peeche chalte hain, tumhein us par iman laane aur neik aamaal se us ki tayyari karne se na roken, warna tum is wajah se barbaad ho jaoge.
17: Aur aey Moosa (alaihis salaam), yeh tumhare daayein haath mein kya hai?
18: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: yeh meri laathi hai: main chalte waqt is par tek lagata hoon, is se apni bakriyon ke liye darakht ke patte jhaadta hoon, aur in ke siwa bhi is ke bahut se kaam hain jin ka maine zikr nahin kiya.
19: Allah ne farmaya: aey Moosa (alaihis salaam), ise daal do.
20: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne use daal diya aur woh ek saanp ban gayi jo tezi se reng raha tha.
21: Allah ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) se farmaya: laathi pakad lo aur is ke saanp ban jaane se na daro. Jab tum ise pakad loge to Main ise us ki pehli haalat par lauta doonga.
22: Aur ab apna haath apne pehlu se laga lo, woh bina kisi beemari ke safed nikal aayega; yeh tumhare liye ek aur nishani hai.
23: Aey Moosa (alaihis salaam), Maine tumhein yeh do nishaniyan is liye dikhayin ke tumhein apni kuch sab se bari nishaniyan dikhaoon jo Meri qudrat batati hain aur yeh ke tum Allah ke bheje hue rasool ho.
24: Aey Moosa (alaihis salaam), Firaun ke paas jao, kyunke woh kufr aur Allah ke khilaaf sarkashi mein hadein phaand gaya hai.
25: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: aey Rubb, mere liye mera seena khol de taake main mushkil utha sakoon.
26: Aur mera kaam aasan kar de.
27: Aur mujhe saaf bolne ki taaqat de.
28: Taake jab main un tak tera paigham pahunchaoon to woh meri baat samajh sakein.
29: Aur mere ghar walon mein se mera ek madadgaar bana de jo mere kaamon mein meri madad kare.
31: Us ke zariye mera irada mazboot kar de.
32: Aur use mere kaam mein mera saajhi bana de.
33: Taake hum teri bahut bahut paaki bayan karein.
34: Aur tujhe bahut bahut yaad karein.
35: Be-shak tu hamesha humein dekh raha hai. Hamara kuch tujh se chhipa nahin.
36: Allah ne farmaya: aey Moosa (alaihis salaam), Maine tumhari darkhwast qabool kar li.
37: Aur Maine ek aur baar bhi tum par ehsan kiya tha.
38: Jab Hum ne tumhari maa ke dil mein woh baat daali jis ke zariye Allah ne tumhein Firaun ki saazish se bachaya.
39: Maine use hukm diya jab Maine us ke dil mein daala: apne bachche ko paida hone ke baad sandooq mein daal do aur phir sandooq ko dariya mein daal do. Dariya use Mere hukm se kinare par daal dega, aur use Mera aur us ka ek dushman le lega, yani Firaun. Aur Maine tum par apni taraf se mohabbat daal di, taake log tum se mohabbat karein, aur taake tum Meri nigraani, Meri hifazat aur Meri dekh-bhaal mein pale.
40: Jab tumhari behan nikli aur sandooq ke peeche peeche gayi jahan jahan woh gaya, aur us ne un logon se kaha jinhon ne use liya: kya main tumhein aisa shaks bata doon jo is ki dekh-bhaal kare, use doodh pilaaye aur use paale? Phir Maine tum par yeh ehsan kiya ke tumhein tumhari maa ki taraf lauta diya taake woh tumhare lautne par khush ho aur tumhare liye gam na kare. Phir tum ne us Qibti ko qatl kar diya jise tum ne mukka maara tha, magar Hum ne tum par ehsan kiya aur tumhein mushkil se bacha liya. Aur Hum ne har us aazmaish mein baar baar tumhari madad ki jo tumhein pesh aayi. Phir tum chale gaye aur kai saal Madyan walon mein rahe, phir tum us waqt par aaye jo tumhare aane ke liye muqarrar tha taake tum se baat ki jaye, aey Moosa (alaihis salaam).
41: Aur Maine tumhein apne rasool ke taur par chun liya taake tum logon tak woh wahi pahunchao jo Maine tumhari taraf bheji.
42: Aey Moosa (alaihis salaam), tum aur tumhara bhai Haroon (alaihis salaam) Meri un nishaniyon ke saath jao jo Allah ki qudrat aur Us ke yakta hone ko batati hain, aur Meri taraf bulane aur Mujhe yaad karne mein susti na karna.
43: Tum dono Firaun ke paas jao, kyunke woh kufr aur Allah ke khilaaf sarkashi mein hadein phaand gaya hai.
44: Aur us se narmi se baat karna, sakhti ke baghair, is umeed par ke woh nasihat le, Allah se dare aur tauba kare.
45: Moosa aur Haroon (alaihimas salaam) ne kaha: humein dar hai ke woh humein jald saza de dega is se pehle ke hum us tak tera paigham pahunchayein, ya woh hum par zulm karne mein hadd se barh jayega aur humein qatl kar dega ya koi aur sakhti karega.
46: Allah ne un dono se farmaya: na daro, Main apni madad aur apne sahare ke saath tum dono ke saath hoon. Main tumhare aur us ke darmiyan jo kuch hoga woh sab sunta aur dekhta hoon.
47: Lihaza us ke paas jao aur us se kaho: aey Firaun, hum tere Rubb ke bheje hue hain, lihaza Bani Israel ko hamare saath bhej de aur unhein un ke beton ko qatl karke aur un ki auraton ko zinda chhod kar saza na de. Hum tere paas tere Rubb ki taraf se ek nishani laaye hain jo hamari sachhaai saabit karti hai. Aur Allah ke azaab se aman un ke liye hai jo iman laate hain aur Allah ki hidayat ki pairvi karte hain.
48: Allah ne hamari taraf wahi ki hai ke duniya aur Aakhirat ka azaab us par padta hai jo Allah ki nishaniyan jhutlata hai aur rasoolon ki laayi hui baat se peeth pher leta hai.
49: Firaunhon ne un ki laayi hui baat ko jhutlate hue kaha: aey Moosa (alaihis salaam), phir tumhara woh Rubb kaun hai jis ke baare mein tum daawa karte ho ke us ne tumhein meri taraf bheja?
50: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: hamara Rubb woh hai jis ne har cheez ko woh shakl aur woh soorat di jo us ke munasib thi, aur phir Us ne har makhlooq ko us kaam ki hidayat di jis ke liye woh banayi gayi.
51: Firaunhon ne kaha: phir un pichli ummaton ka kya haal hai jinhon ne kufr kiya?
52: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne Firaun se kaha: un ummaton ke aamaal ka ilm mere Rubb ke paas hai, Lauh-e-Mehfooz mein likha hua. Mera Rubb na cheezon ke apne ilm mein galti karta hai aur na kisi cheez ko bhoolta hai.
53: Mera Rubb wahi hai jis ne tumhare liye zameen bichha di taake tum us par raho, aur us par tumhare liye raaste banaye taake tum un par chalo. Aur Us ne aasman se baarish ka paani utara aur us paani se har tarah ke podey nikale.
54: Aey logo, un paak cheezon mein se khao jo Maine tumhare liye nikali hain, aur apne maweshi charao. Jo naimatein zikr hui hain, un mein aql walon ke liye Allah ki qudrat aur Us ke yakta hone ki nishaniyan hain.
55: Zameen ki mitti se Maine tumhare baap Adam (alaihis salaam) ko paida kiya, usi mein Main tumhein lautaoonga jab tum wafat paoge aur dafn kiye jaoge, aur usi se Main tumhein doosri baar nikaaloonga jab tum Qayamat ke din dobara zinda kiye jaoge.
56: Aur Maine Firaun ko apni nau ki nau nishaniyan dikhayin. Us ne un sab ko dekha magar unhein jhutlaya aur Allah par iman la kar jawab dene se inkaar kiya.
57: Firaunhon ne kaha: aey Moosa (alaihis salaam), kya tum apne laaye hue jaadu se humein Misr se nikaalne aaye ho, taake tum us par qaaboo paa lo?
58: Aey Moosa (alaihis salaam), hum bhi tumhare paas tumhare jaisa jaadu zaroor laayenge, lihaza hamare aur apne darmiyan ek muqarrar waqt aur jagah tai kar lo jis ki hum mein se koi khilaaf-warzi na kare, aur yeh jagah dono giroh ke liye beech ki aur barabar ki jagah ho.
59: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne Firaun se kaha: hamare aur tumhare darmiyan waqt eid ke din ka hoga jab log tehwar manane ke liye subah ke waqt jama honge.
60: Firaun wapas gaya aur apni chaalein aur apne hathkande jama kiye. Phir woh muqabale ke muqarrar waqt aur jagah par aa gaya.
61: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne Firaun ke jaadugaron ko nasihat karte hue kaha: khabardar, Allah par us jaadu ke zariye jhoot na ghado jis se tum logon ko dhoka dete ho, warna Woh tumhein apni taraf se ek azaab se mita dega. Aur jo shaks Allah par jhoot ghadta hai woh ghaate mein hai.
62: Jaadugaron ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ki baat sun kar aapas mein jhagda kiya aur chhup kar mashwara kiya.
63: Jaadugaron ne ek doosre se chhup kar kaha: Moosa (alaihis salaam) aur Haroon (alaihis salaam) dono jaadugar hain. Un ka irada yeh hai ke apne laaye hue jaadu se tumhein Misr se nikaal dein aur tumhare buland tareeqe aur tumhare aala deen ko khatam kar dein.
64: Lihaza apna pakka faisla kar lo aur us mein ikhtilaaf na karo. Phir safon mein aage barho aur jo tumhare paas hai use ek saath daal do. Aur aaj jo apne mukhalif ko shikast de dega wahi apni manzil paa lega.
65: Jaadugaron ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) se kaha: aey Moosa, tumhare paas do mein se ek raasta hai: ya to tum pehle apna jaadu daalo, ya hum pehle daalein.
66: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: nahin, tum hi pehle apna daalo. Chunanche unhon ne apna daal diya, aur achanak un ki rassiyan aur un ki laathiyan, jo unhon ne daali theen, un ke jaadu ki wajah se Moosa ko aisi lagin jaise tezi se rengte hue saanp hon.
67: Moosa (alaihis salaam) apne dil mein dar gaye, yeh soch kar ke woh un par chadh aayenge.
68: Allah ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko tasalli dete hue farmaya: jo tumhein nazar aa raha hai us se na daro. Aey Moosa, tumhara hi un par haath ooncha hai aur tum hi ghalib aaoge.
69: Aur woh laathi daal do jo tumhare daayein haath mein hai: woh ek saanp ban jayegi aur un ka banaya hua jaadu nigal jayegi. Unhon ne to sirf jaadu ka ek fareb banaya hai, aur jaadugar jahan bhi ho apni manzil nahin paata.
70: Chunanche Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne apni laathi daal di aur woh saanp ban gayi aur jaadugaron ka banaya hua sab kuch nigal gayi. Phir tamam jaadugar Allah ko sajde mein gir pade jab unhein maaloom ho gaya ke Moosa ke paas jo tha woh jaadu nahin balke Allah ki taraf se tha, aur unhon ne kaha: hum Moosa aur Haroon (alaihis salaam) ke Rubb par iman laaye, jo tamam makhlooq ka Rubb hai.
71: Firaunhon ne jaadugaron ke iman ko rad karte hue aur unhein dhamkate hue kaha: kya tum Moosa (alaihis salaam) par iman le aaye is se pehle ke main tumhein is ki ijazat deta? Aey jaadugaro, zaroor Moosa hi tumhara ustaad hoga jis ne tumhein jaadu sikhaya. Main zaroor tum mein se har ek ka ek haath aur ek paon mukhalif simton se kaat doonga, phir main tumhare jism khajoor ke tanon par suli chadha doonga yahan tak ke tum mar jao. Tum doosron ke liye ek sabaq ban jaoge aur tab tumhein maaloom hoga ke hum mein se kis ka azaab zyada sakht aur zyada der tak rehne wala hai: mera ya Moosa ke Rubb ka?
72: Jaadugaron ne Firaun se kaha: aey Firaun, hum un khuli nishaniyon par, jo hamare paas aa chuki hain, kabhi teri pairvi ko tarjeeh nahin denge. Aur hum us Allah par kabhi tujhe tarjeeh nahin denge jis ne humein paida kiya. Lihaza hamare saath jo chahe kar le: tera hum par zor sirf is guzar jaane wali zindagi mein hai, aur tera zor jald khatam ho jayega.
73: Hum apne Rubb par iman laaye, is umeed par ke Woh hum se hamare pichle kufr ke aur doosre gunah mita de, aur hum se jaadu ka woh gunah bhi mita de jise seekhne, karne aur Moosa (alaihis salaam) ka muqabla karne par tu ne humein majboor kiya. Aur Allah ke paas us se behtar ajr hai jis ka tu hum se wada karta hai, aur Us ka azaab us azaab se zyada der tak rehne wala hai jis se tu humein dhamkaata hai.
74: Aur baat ka khulasa yeh hai ke jo log Qayamat ke din apne Rubb ke paas kafir ban kar aayenge woh Aag mein daakhil honge aur us mein hamesha rahenge. Wahan woh na marenge ke us ke azaab se chhutkara paa lein, aur na woh koi khushgawar zindagi jiyenge.
75: Aur jo log Qayamat ke din apne Rubb ke paas momin ban kar aayenge jinhon ne neik kaam kiye, aise logon ko Jannat mein buland thikane aur buland darje ata kiye jayenge.
76: Woh darje hamesha rehne ke baagh hain jin ke mahalon ke neeche nahrein behti hain, aur woh un mein hamesha rahenge. Yahi un logon ka badla hai jo apne aap ko kufr aur gunahon se paak karte hain.
77: Aur Maine Moosa (alaihis salaam) ki taraf wahi ki ke Mere bandon ko raat ke waqt Misr se le jao taake koi unhein na dekhe, aur laathi se samundar par maar kar un ke liye samundar mein ek khushk raasta bana do, aman ke saath, na is ka dar karte hue ke Firaun aur us ki qaum tum tak pahunch jayegi aur na samundar mein doobne ka khauf karte hue.
78: Phir Firaunhon ne apne lashkaron ke saath un ka peechha kiya. Phir use aur us ke lashkaron ko samundar ke us hisse ne gher liya jis ki haqeeqat sirf Allah hi jaanta hai. Woh sab doob gaye aur halak ho gaye, jab ke Moosa (alaihis salaam) aur jo un ke saath the woh bach gaye.
79: Aur Firaunhon ne apni qaum ko gumraah kiya: unhein kufr khoobsurat kar dikha kar aur unhein baatil se dhoka de kar, aur us ne unhein hidayat ke raaste ki taraf rehnumai nahin ki.
80: Aur Maine Bani Israel se, Firaun aur us ke lashkaron se bachane ke baad, kaha: aey Bani Israel, Maine tumhein tumhare dushman se bacha liya, aur Maine tum se wada kiya ke Main Moosa (alaihis salaam) se Koh-e-Toor ke paas waadi ke daayein kinare par baat karoonga, aur Maine tum par, jab tum bhatak rahe the, aisa khana utara jo tum kha sako, jo meetha hai aur gond jaisa hai, aur aise parinde bhi jo bater jaise hain.
81: Un halal aur paak cheezon mein se khao jo Maine tumhein rozi mein di hain, aur un se aage na barho jo Maine tumhare liye halal kiya, ke woh kha jao jo Maine tum par haraam kiya, warna tum par Mera gussa aa padega. Aur jis par Mera gussa aa pade woh barbaad ho gaya aur Jahannam mein ja pada.
82: Aur Main us shaks ke liye bahut Bakhshne wala aur darguzar karne wala hoon jo Meri taraf tauba kare, neik kaam kare aur phir haqq par jama rahe.
83: Aur aey Moosa (alaihis salaam), tumhein kis cheez ne apni qaum se jald aane par aamada kiya aur tum unhein peeche chhod aaye?
84: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: woh mere peeche hi hain. Woh mujh tak pahunch jayenge. Main apni qaum se pehle teri taraf aaya, taake tu mere jald teri taraf aane se mujh se raazi ho.
85: Allah ne farmaya: Maine tumhari us qaum ko aazmaya jise tum peeche chhod aaye, bachhde ki ibadat se. Samiri ne unhein us ki ibadat ki taraf bulaya aur is ke zariye unhein gumraah kiya.
86: Phir Moosa apni qaum ki taraf laute, un ke bachhde ki ibadat par gusse mein aur un par gamgeen. Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: aey meri qaum, kya Allah ne tum se achha wada nahin kiya tha ke Woh tum par Taurat utarega aur tumhein Jannat mein daakhil karega? Kya tum par lambi muddat guzar gayi ke tum bhool gaye? Ya tum ne apne is kaam se yeh chaaha ke tum par tumhare Rubb ka gussa utre aur Us ka azaab tum par aa pade, aur isi liye tum ne mujh se kiya hua woh wada toda ke mere lautne tak itaat par jame rahoge?
87: Moosa ki qaum ne kaha: aey Moosa (alaihis salaam), hum ne aap se kiya hua wada apni marzi se nahin toda, balke majboori mein. Hum ne Firaun ki qaum ke zeewar ke bhaari bojh uthaye hue the aur hum ne unhein un se chhutkara paane ke liye ek garhe mein daal diya. Magar jab hum ne unhein garhe mein daala, to Samiri ne us mein woh mitti daal di jo us ke paas Jibreel (alaihis salaam) ke ghode ke sum se thi.
88: Chunanche Samiri ne Bani Israel ke is zeewar se ek bachhde ka be-jaan jism nikaal liya, jis se gaay jaisi aawaz nikalti thi. Un mein se jo log Samiri ke is kaam se fitne mein pad gaye, unhon ne kaha: yahi tumhara maabood hai aur Moosa (alaihis salaam) ka bhi maabood, jise woh bhool gaye aur yahan chhod gaye.
89: Kya yeh log, jo bachhde ke fitne mein pad kar us ki ibadat karne lage, yeh nahin dekhte ke bachhda na bolta hai aur na unhein koi jawab deta hai, aur na us mein yeh taaqat hai ke un se ya kisi aur se koi nuqsan hataye ya apne liye ya kisi aur ke liye koi faida laaye?
90: Aur Haroon (alaihis salaam) ne un se Moosa (alaihis salaam) ke lautne se pehle kaha tha: sone se is bachhde ka banna aur us ka bolna sirf tumhari aazmaish ke liye hai, taake momin kafir se alag ho jaye. Aur aey meri qaum, tumhara Rubb Allah hai, lihaza mere peeche chalo aur sirf Usi ki ibadat karo, aur mere is hukm par chalo ke Us ke siwa doosron ki ibadat chhod do.
91: Jo log bachhde ki ibadat ke fitne mein pad gaye the, unhon ne kaha: hum us ki ibadat karte rahenge yahan tak ke Moosa (alaihis salaam) hamare paas laut aayein.
92: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne apne bhai Haroon (alaihis salaam) se kaha: tumhein kis cheez ne roka, jab tum ne unhein Allah ke siwa bachhde ki ibadat karke bhatakte dekha,
93: Ke tum unhein chhod kar mere saath aa milte? Kya tum ne mere us hukm ki nafarmani ki jo maine tumhein un par apna janasheen banate waqt diya tha?
94: Jab Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne apne bhai ko daarhi aur sar se pakad kar kheencha aur un ke kiye par unhein daanta, to Haroon (alaihis salaam) ne un se un ki shafqat chaahte hue kaha: meri daarhi aur mere sar ke baal na pakdiye, kyunke mere un ke saath rehne ki ek wajah thi. Mujhe dar tha ke agar main unhein yakta chhod doon to woh bikhar jayenge, phir aap kahenge ke maine unhein baant diya aur maine un ke baare mein aap ki wasiyat ka paas na kiya.
95: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne Samiri se kaha: aey Samiri, tera kya maamla hai? Tujhe kis cheez ne is par aamada kiya jo tu ne kiya?
96: Samiri ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) se kaha: maine woh dekha jo unhon ne nahin dekha: maine Jibreel (alaihis salaam) ko ek ghode par dekha, to maine un ke ghode ke qadamon ki mitti ki ek mutthi li aur use pighle hue zeewar par daal diya jise bachhde ki shakl mein dhaala gaya tha. Is se ek bachhde ka jism ban gaya jis se bolne ki aawaz nikalti thi. Aur meri jaan ne mera kiya hua kaam mujhe isi tarah khoobsurat kar dikhaya.
97: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne Samiri se kaha: ja, ab tere liye likh diya gaya hai ke tu zindagi bhar kehta rahega: 'na main chhuoonga aur na mujhe chhua jaye.' Tu ek alag-thalag shaks ki tarah jiyega, aur tere liye Qayamat ke din ek waada kiya hua waqt hai jis mein tera hisaab hoga aur tujhe saza di jayegi. Aur Allah tujh se kiya hua yeh wada kabhi nahin todega. Aur apne us bachhde ki taraf dekh jise tu ne apna maabood bana rakha tha aur jis ki tu Allah ke siwa ibadat karta raha. Hum use aag mein jalayenge yahan tak ke woh pighal jaye, phir hum use samundar mein bikhair denge yahan tak ke us ka koi nishan baaqi na rahe.
98: Aey logo, tumhara sachcha maabood sirf Allah hai, jis ke siwa koi sachcha maabood nahin. Us ne apne ilm se har cheez ko gher rakha hai; sirf Wohi har cheez jaanta hai aur Us ke ilm se kuch nahin bachta.
99: Aey Rasool, jis tarah Maine aap ko Moosa (alaihis salaam), Firaun aur un ki qaumon ka qissa sunaya, usi tarah Main aap ko aap se pehle ke nabiyon aur ummaton ke waqiyat sunata hoon, taake woh aap ke liye tasalli hon. Aur Maine aap ko apni taraf se ek Quran diya hai jis ke zariye un logon ko nasihat hoti hai jo nasihat chahte hain.
100: Aur jo shaks is Quran se munh mod le jo aap par utara gaya, aur us par iman na laaye aur us ke mutabiq amal na kare, woh Qayamat ke din ek bada gunah uthaye aayega aur dardnaak azaab ka haqdaar hoga.
101: Woh is azaab mein hamesha rahega. Aur Qayamat ke din woh bojh kitna bura hoga jo woh uthaye hue honge.
102: Jis din farishta dobara zinda karne ke liye doosri baar soor phoonkega, aur Main us din kafiron ko neeli aankhon ke saath jama karoonga, us ki wajah yeh hai ke Aakhirat ki shadeed haulnaakiyon ki wajah se un ka rang aur un ki aankhein badal chuki hongi.
103: Woh aapas mein dhime se baat karenge aur kahenge: tum maut ke baad barzakh mein sirf das raatein hi rahe.
104: Main khoob jaanta hoon jo woh aapas mein chhup kar kehte hain, aur us mein se kuch Mujh se nahin bachta, jab un mein sab se zyada samajhdaar kahega: tum barzakh mein sirf ek din rahe, is se zyada nahin.
105: Aey Rasool, woh aap se Qayamat ke din pahaadon ke haal ke baare mein poochte hain. Un se keh dijiye: mera Rubb pahaadon ko un ki jadon se ukhaad kar bikhair dega, phir woh dhool ban jayenge.
106: Phir Woh us zameen ko, jo unhein uthaye hue thi, ek hamwaar maidan chhod dega jis par na koi imarat hogi aur na koi sabza.
107: Aey dekhne wale, tum us zameen par, us ke poori tarah hamwaar hone ki wajah se, na koi mod dekhoge, na koi oonchaai aur na koi gaddha.
108: Us din log pukarne wale ki aawaz ke peeche hashr ke maidan ki taraf chalenge. Koi cheez unhein us ke peeche chalne se nahin moadegi. Aur Rehman ke saamne aawazein khauf se dab jayengi, is liye us din tum sar-goshi ke siwa kuch nahin sunoge.
109: Is bade din kisi sifarish karne wale ki sifarish faida nahin degi, siwaye us ke jise Allah sifarish ki ijazat de aur jis ki sifarish ki baat se Allah raazi ho.
110: Allah jaanta hai ke log aakhiri ghadi mein kis se saamna karenge, aur Woh jaanta hai ke woh apni duniya ki zindagi mein kya chhod aaye hain. Aur tamam bande mil kar bhi Allah ki zaat aur Us ki sifaat ke ilm ka ihata nahin kar sakte.
111: Aur bandon ke chehre us Zinda Hasti ke saamne jhuk jayenge jo kabhi nahin marti aur jo apne bandon ke kaam un ka intezam aur un ki dekh-bhaal karke chalati hai. Aur jo gunah uthaye hue hoga woh ghaate mein hai, kyunke us ne apne aap ko halakat ki jaghon tak pahuncha diya.
112: Aur jo shaks Allah aur Us ke rasoolon par iman rakhte hue neik kaam karega use us ka poora ajr milega, aur use na is zulm ka dar hoga ke use kisi aise gunah ki saza di jaye jo us ne kiya hi nahin, aur na is ka ke us ki nekiyon ke ajr mein kami ki jaye.
113: Aur Maine Quran saaf Arabi mein utara, jaise Maine pichle nabiyon ke qisse utare, aur Maine us mein tarah tarah ki tambeehein aur daraane wali baatein khol kar bayan kein, is umeed par ke woh Allah se darein ya Quran ki nasihat unhein gaur karne par le aaye.
114: Allah un kamiyon se buland aur paak hai jo mushrik Us ki taraf mansoob karte hain, aur un sharikon se bhi jo woh Us ke liye thehrate hain. Wohi Badshah hai jis ki azmat hai, har cheez ki baadshahat jis ki hai, aur Wohi Haqq hai aur haqq hi kehta hai. Aur aey Rasool, Quran Jibreel (alaihis salaam) ke saath padhne mein jaldi na kijiye is se pehle ke woh poori tarah aap tak pahuncha diya jaye, aur kahiye: aey Rubb, mujhe us ilm ke oopar aur ilm de jo tu ne mujhe sikha diya.
115: Aur Maine is se pehle Adam (alaihis salaam) ko hukm diya tha ke woh us darakht mein se na khayein, aur Maine unhein is se roka aur unhein is ka anjaam bhi bataya. Magar woh hukm bhool gaye, us darakht mein se kha liya aur apne aap ko rok na sake. Aur Maine un mein us hukm par qayam rehne ka pakka irada na paaya jo Maine diya tha.
116: Aur aey Rasool, woh waqt yaad kijiye jab Maine farishton se kaha: Adam (alaihis salaam) ko izzat ka sajda karo. Un sab ne sajda kiya siwaye Iblis ke, jo un ke saath tha magar un mein se nahin tha. Us ne gurur mein aa kar sajda karne se inkaar kiya.
117: Chunanche Maine kaha: aey Adam (alaihis salaam), Iblis tumhara aur tumhari biwi ka dushman hai, lihaza woh tumhein aur tumhari biwi ko Jannat se na nikalwa de, is tarah ke tum us ke waswase mein us ki baat maan lo, warna tum mushkilon aur takleef mein pad jaoge.
118: Allah ka tum par yeh zimma hai ke Woh tumhein khilayega, is liye tum bhooke nahin rahoge, aur tumhein pehnaayega, is liye tum nange nahin hoge.
119: Aur tumhein paani dega taake tum pyaase na raho, aur tum par saya karega taake sooraj ki garmi tum par asar na kare.
120: Magar shaytan ne Adam (alaihis salaam) ke dil mein waswasa daala aur kaha: kya main tumhein ek aisa darakht bataoon ke jo us mein se khaye woh kabhi na mare balke hamesha baaqi rahe, aur use aisi baadshahat mile jo kabhi na toote aur na khatam ho?
121: Phir Adam (alaihis salaam) aur Hawwa ne us darakht mein se kha liya jis se unhein khane se roka gaya tha, phir un ke sharm ke hisse un par khul gaye jo pehle chhipe hue the, aur woh Jannat ke darakhton ke patte tod kar un se apne sharm ke hisse dhaapne lage. Aur Adam ne apne Rubb ke hukm ke khilaaf kiya, kyunke unhon ne us darakht mein se na khane ke Us ke hukm par amal na kiya, aur is tarah woh us hadd se aage barh gaye jo un ke liye jaiz thi.
122: Phir Allah ne unhein chun liya, un ki tauba qabool kar li aur unhein hidayat ki taufeeq di.
123: Allah ne Adam (alaihis salaam) aur Hawwa se farmaya: tum dono aur Iblis, Jannat se utar jao, kyunke woh tumhara dushman hai aur tum us ke dushman ho. Phir agar tumhare paas Meri taraf se Mere raaste ki koi wazahat aa jaye, to tum mein se jo Mere raaste ki us wazahat ki pairvi kare, us ke mutabiq amal kare aur us se na hate, woh na haqq se bhatkega aur na Aakhirat mein azaab se bad-naseeb hoga, balke Allah use Jannat mein daakhil karega.
124: Aur jo Meri nasihat se munh mod le aur use na maane aur na us ki pukar par labbaik kahe, us ke liye duniya mein aur barzakh mein tang aur dukh-bhari zindagi hogi, aur Main use Qayamat ke din hashr ke maidan ki taraf bina nazar aur bina daleel ke le jaoonga.
125: Yeh shaks kahega: aey Rubb, tu ne aaj mujhe andha kyun uthaya jab ke main duniya mein dekh sakta tha?
126: Allah use rad karte hue farmayega: yeh waisa hi hai jaisa tu ne duniya mein kiya, kyunke Meri nishaniyan tere paas aayin magar tu ne un se munh moad liya aur unhein chhod diya. Isi tarah aaj tujhe azaab mein chhod diya jayega.
127: Aur Main us shaks ko aisa hi badla deta hoon jo na-jaiz khwahishon mein doob jaye aur apne Rubb ki khuli dalilon par iman laane se munh mod le. Aur Aakhirat mein Allah ka azaab is se bhi zyada bhayanak, zyada sakht aur zyada der tak rehne wala hai, us zindagi ke muqable mein jo unhein duniya mein aur barzakh mein milegi.
128: Kya mushrikon par yeh wazeh nahin ke Maine un se pehle kitni hi qaumein halak kar deen? Woh in halak ki hui qaumon ke gharon mein chalte phirte hain aur un ke saath jo kuch hua us ke nishan dekhte hain. In bahut si qaumon par aane wali halakat aur barbaadi mein aql walon ke liye sabaq hain.
129: Aey Rasool, agar aap ke Rubb ki taraf se pehle hi yeh baat tai na ho chuki hoti ke Woh kisi ko hujjat qayam kiye baghair azaab nahin dega, aur agar Us ke paas ek muqarrar waqt na hota, to un par azaab jald aa jata, kyunke woh is ke haqdaar hain.
130: Lihaza aey Rasool, un jhooti baaton par sabr kijiye jo aap ke jhutlane wale aap ke baare mein kehte hain. Aur apne Rubb ki paaki aur Us ki taarif bayan kijiye: Fajr ki namaz mein sooraj nikalne se pehle; Asr ki namaz mein sooraj doobne se pehle; raat ki ghadiyon mein Maghrib aur Isha ki namazon mein; aur Zuhr ki namaz mein sooraj dhalne ke foran baad, jo din ke pehle hisse ka aakhir aur doosre hisse ka shuru hai; is umeed par ke aap ko Allah ke paas aisa ajr mile jis se aap raazi hon.
131: Aur un tarah tarah ke mazon ki chaahat na kijiye jo Maine kafiron ke mukhtalif giroh ko diye, yani duniya ki zindagi ki woh chamak jis se woh maze lete hain taake Main unhein aazmaoon. Jo kuch Maine unhein is mein se diya woh mit jayega, aur aap ke Rubb ka woh ajr jis ka Us ne aap se wada kiya aur jo aap ko raazi kar dega, is se behtar aur zyada der tak rehne wala hai.
132: Aur aey Rasool, apne ghar walon ko namaz padhne ka hukm dijiye, aur aap khud bhi us par qayam rahiye. Main aap se na aap ki apni rozi maangta hoon aur na kisi aur ki; aap ki rozi ka zimma Main loonga. Aur duniya aur Aakhirat mein taarif ke laayak anjaam un parhezgaaron ke liye hai jo Allah se darte hain, Us ke hukm par chalte hain aur Us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bachte hain.
133: Aur Nabi ﷺ ko jhutlane wale in kafiron ne kaha: Muhammad ﷺ hamare paas apne Rubb ki taraf se koi nishani kyun nahin laate jo un ki sachhaai saabit kare aur yeh ke woh Rasool hain? Kya in jhutlane walon ke paas woh Quran nahin aaya jo pichli aasmani kitabon ki tasdeeq karta hai?
134: Aur agar Main Nabi ﷺ ke in jhutlane walon ko un ke kufr aur un ki hath-dharmi ki wajah se un par azaab bhej kar halak kar deta, is se pehle ke un ki taraf koi rasool bhejta aur un par koi kitab utarta, to woh Qayamat ke din apne kufr ke uzr mein kehte: aey Rubb, kaash tu ne duniya mein hamari taraf koi rasool bheja hota, taake hum us par iman laate aur un aayaton ki pairvi karte jo woh laaya, is se pehle ke tere azaab se hum par zillat aur ruswai aati.
135: Aey Rasool, in jhutlane walon se keh dijiye: hum mein se aur tum mein se har ek us cheez ka muntazir hai jo Allah karne wala hai, lihaza intezar karo. Tum zaroor jaan loge ke seedhe raaste wale aur hidayat paane wale kaun hain: hum ya tum?
